technical-summary: The stored-plan static key hashed handoff.histogram, which a session derives as <run-dir>/heat.live whenever the config states none, so every start of a helper config under a new run directory produced a new key and never reused its measured plan. The key now keeps only whether live heat recording is on or off. Test added: two run-directory heat paths give one key, off differs.
user-summary-candidate: Starting a helper configuration again now reuses its last measured plan instead of measuring every time.
